	,EAB.insert_dttm AS EAB_insert_dttm
	,LEFT(RIGHT(EAB.FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS EAB_Business_Date

	,YDAB.PREVIOUS_CLEARBAL AS PREVIOUS_CLEARBAL

	,YDAB.ACCUMULATED_CLEARBAL AS ACCUMULATED_CLEARBAL
	,LEFT(YDAB.FILE_NAME, 5) AS YTD_BNK_CODE
	,RIGHT(LEFT(YDAB.FILE_NAME, 9), 3) AS YTD_SOURCE_CODE
	,YDAB.FILE_NAME AS YTD_FILE_NAME
	,YDAB.insert_dttm AS YTD_insert_dttm
	,LEFT(RIGHT(YDAB.FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS YTD_Business_Date



	------CURRENCY CONVERSION------
	,EAB.TRAN_DATE_BAL AS OUTSTANDING_BALANCE
	,0 AS PREVIOUS_MONTHEND_AVERAGE_DAILY_BALANCE
	,CAST(YDAB.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL / DATEPART(DAYOFYEAR, CONVERT(CHAR(10),  LEFT(RIGHT(YDAB.FILE_NAME, 12),8), 120)) AS DECIMAL(25,4)) YEAR_TO_DATE_AVERAGE_DAILY_BALANCE
	,CAST(CASE WHEN GAM.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE = 'PHP' THEN EAB.TRAN_DATE_BAL
		  ELSE EAB.TRAN_DATE_BAL * BCC.ConversionRate END AS DECIMAL(25,4)) OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP
	,0 AS PREVIOUS_MONTHEND_AVERAGE_DAILY_BALANCE_PHP
	,CASE WHEN GAM.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE = 'PHP' THEN YDAB.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL / DATEPART(DAYOFYEAR, CONVERT(CHAR(10),  LEFT(RIGHT(YDAB.FILE_NAME, 12),8), 120))
		  ELSE (YDAB.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL / DATEPART(DAYOFYEAR, CONVERT(CHAR(10), LEFT(RIGHT(YDAB.FILE_NAME, 12),8), 120))) * BCC.ConversionRate END  YEAR_TO_DATE_AVERAGE_DAILY_BALANCE_PHP
	,DATEPART(DAYOFYEAR, CONVERT(CHAR(10),  LEFT(RIGHT(YDAB.FILE_NAME, 12),8), 120)) AS DAY_OF_YEAR 
	,CAST(CASE WHEN GAM.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE = 'PHP' THEN 1 ELSE BCC.ConversionRate END AS DECIMAL(15,10)) CONVERSION_RATE


	------OTHER------
	,'NA' AS MONTH_YEAR
	,'NA' AS MTD_BANK_ID
	,'NA' AS MTD_SOL_ID
	,'NA' AS MTD_SCHM_CODE
	,'NA' AS MTD_SCHM_TYPE
	,'NA' AS MTD_ACID
	,'NA' AS MTD_FORACID
	,'NA' AS MTD_ACCT_CRNCY_CODE
	,'1900-01-01' AS TRANDATE
	,0 AS AVE_CURR_BALANCE
	,0 AS AVE_CLR_BALANCE
	,0 AS NO_DAYS
	,'NA' AS USERID
	,'1900-01-01' AS MTD_LCHG_TIME
	,'NA' AS QUARTER_YEAR
	,'NA' AS MTD_LAST6_ACC_NUM
	,'NA' AS MTD_BNK_CODE
	,'NA' AS MTD_SOURCE_CODE
	,'NA' AS MTD_FILE_NAME
	,'1900-01-01' AS MTD_INSERT_DTTM
	,'2024-01-25' AS As_Of_Date
	,CASE
		WHEN GAM.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'Y' 
			AND GAM.ACCT_CLS_DATE <= '2024-01-25'
			AND GAM.SCHM_TYPE IN ('CAA', 'SBA', 'TDA')
			THEN 'C'
		WHEN GAM.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'N'
			AND GAM.SCHM_TYPE IN ('CAA', 'SBA')
			THEN CASA.ACCT_STATUS
		WHEN GAM.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'Y' 
			AND GAM.ACCT_CLS_DATE > '2024-01-25'
			AND GAM.SCHM_TYPE IN ('CAA', 'SBA')
			THEN CASA.ACCT_STATUS
		WHEN GAM.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'Y' 
			AND GAM.ACCT_CLS_DATE > '2024-01-25'
			AND GAM.SCHM_TYPE IN ('TDA')
			THEN TD.ACCT_STATUS
		WHEN GAM.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'N'
			AND GAM.SCHM_TYPE IN ('TDA')
			THEN TD.ACCT_STATUS
	END AS DEP_Account_Status			
	FROM (SELECT * FROM D360.STG_DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTERFULL WHERE H = 'D' AND CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS DATE) = '2024-01-25' ) GAM 

	LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM D360.STG_DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCEFULL WHERE H = 'D' AND CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS DATE) = '2024-01-25' ) EAB 
	ON GAM.ACID = EAB.ACID AND GAM.BANK_ID = EAB.BANK_ID
	LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM D360.STG_DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCESFULL WHERE H = 'D' AND CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS DATE) = '2024-01-25') YDAB 
	ON GAM.ACID = YDAB.ACID AND GAM.BANK_ID = YDAB.BANK_ID
	LEFT JOIN  (SELECT * FROM bnkm.currencyconversion where ConvertToCurrencyId = 'PHP' AND RateId = 'REV' AND CurrencyConversionTimestamp = '2024-01-25' ) BCC ON 
	GAM.BANK_ID = BCC.FinancialInstitutionId
	AND GAM.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE = BCC.ConvertFromCurrencyId

	LEFT JOIN EDS.DEP_CASAMASTER CASA
		ON GAM.ACID = CASA.ACID
		AND GAM.BANK_ID = CASA.BANK_ID
		AND '2024-01-25' BETWEEN CASA.SCD_START_DATE AND CASA.SCD_END_DATE
	LEFT JOIN EDS.DEP_TDMASTER TD
		ON GAM.ACID = TD.ACID
		AND GAM.BANK_ID = TD.BANK_ID
		AND '2024-01-25' BETWEEN TD.SCD_START_DATE AND TD.SCD_END_DATE

)

    , (COALESCE(TMP.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP,0) + COALESCE((CASE WHEN TMP.DAY = 1 THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(CURRENT_PBD.MTD_AGG_BAL_PHP,0) + (WH_DAY_DIFF_MONTH * CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP) END) ,0)) AS MTD_AGG_BAL_PHP
    , ((COALESCE(TMP.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE,0) + COALESCE((CASE WHEN TMP.DAY = 1 THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(CURRENT_PBD.MTD_AGG_BAL_ORIG_CURR,0) + (WH_DAY_DIFF_MONTH * CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE) END) ,0)) / TMP.DAY) AS MTD_ADB_ORIG_CURR

FROM
    (
 		SELECT
			  DEPOSIT_ALLCOLS_FACT.*
			, (CASE WHEN DEP_ACCOUNT_STATUS = 'C' THEN FULLDATE ELSE AS_OF_DATE END) AOD_LATESTC
			,  CASE
				WHEN LEFT(DEPOSIT_ALLCOLS_FACT.CIF_ID,1) = 'R' then 'Retail'
				WHEN LEFT(DEPOSIT_ALLCOLS_FACT.CIF_ID,1) = 'C' then 'Corporate'
			  END AS CUSTOMER_TYPE
			, FULLDATE
            , PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY
            , BUSINESS_DAY_FLAG
            , DAYOFYEAR
            , YEAR
			, DATE_DIM.MONTH_END
			, DAY
			, (DATEDIFF(DAY, GREATEST(PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY,DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, FULLDATE), 0)), FULLDATE)-1) WH_DAY_DIFF_MONTH    
			, (DATEDIFF(DAY, GREATEST(PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY,DATEADD(YEAR, DATEDIFF(YEAR, 0, FULLDATE), 0)), FULLDATE)-1) WH_DAY_DIFF_YEAR     
          FROM EDS.DATE_DIM
          JOIN DEPOSIT_ALLCOLS_FACT
            ON 1 = 1
            AND SUBSTRING(GAM_SCHM_CODE, 1, 2) <> '09'
			AND DEL_FLG = 'N'
            JOIN (SELECT MAX(AS_OF_DATE) MAX_AS_OF_DATE FROM DEPOSIT_ALLCOLS_FACT WHERE AS_OF_DATE <= CAST('2024-01-25' AS DATE)) MX
            ON MX.MAX_AS_OF_DATE = AS_OF_DATE  OR (DEP_ACCOUNT_STATUS = 'C' AND CAST('2024-01-25' AS DATE)>=AS_OF_DATE )
        WHERE (FULLDATE =CAST('2024-01-25' AS DATE) )  
    ) TMP
LEFT JOIN EDS.DEPOSIT_FACT CURRENT_PBD
    ON  TMP.Previous_Business_Day = CURRENT_PBD.AS_OF_DATE
        AND TMP.GAM_ACID = CURRENT_PBD.GAM_ACID
